canonical_project: Cloud X AI data center (En+ / Ust-Ilimsk)
owner: Cloud X (OOO Kloud Soluenshen, En+ holding)
notes: Planned/largest data center in Russia at 154 MW consumption for AI and cloud workloads, sited in Ust-Ilimsk near Ust-Ilimsk HPP (Irkutsk oblast); construction start reported by Kommersant and regional press; ~60 bln RUB investment; two further 154 MW data centers announced near Ust-Ilimsk HPP.
